material.title: Arc UI · React 动效组件库（免费部分）
material.summary: 以可复制的 React / TypeScript 和 CSS Modules 提供日常控件、图表与完整区块。归档 120 个免费组件、22 个免费区块及共享设计与动效 tokens，八组中文样例运行真实上游代码。
material.demoNote: 组件逻辑和 CSS 保留原样；样例界面、中文文案、价格和图表数据为本库编写。只包含公开免费部分。
material.install: 复制 source/upstream/ 中的组件与共享 tokens，保持 @/ 路径别名；本地样例已捆绑依赖。重建：进入 source/，运行 npm ci 与 npm run build。

license.name: MIT（免费组件与代码）；SIL OFL 1.1（字体）
license.scope: 免费 registry、lib、类型、文档与安装条目；不包含 Arc Pro 源码。
license.notes: 保留上游 MIT、运行依赖许可和 Inter / Geist OFL 原文；网站品牌与 Pro 商业许可不随软件许可转移。

useCases: React 产品中的状态控件和微交互
需要源码所有权与本地修改的界面
以 CSS 语义 tokens 统一主题的组件组合
通过 registry、CLI 或 Agent 取用组件的流程
avoid: 将其当作可直接引入的同名 npm 运行包
在非 React 项目中只复制 CSS 来冒充组件行为
把官网 Pro 目录或展示录像视为已归档的免费源码
constraints: 固定归档 df3a600 的 144 个 registry 条目：120 个 registry:ui、22 个 registry:block 和 2 个共享基础条目。
上游要求 React 19、TypeScript 与 Next.js 或 Vite；本地以 React 19.3.0、Motion 13.4.0 和固定锁文件捆绑八组样例。
source/upstream/ 的 registry、lib、types、public/r 与根使用说明保留原始结构和字节，未引入上游的维护检查脚本。
样例数据、状态与操作仅作用于当前页面，不接入账户、支付或持久化服务。
浏览器实测覆盖本地 Chromium 桌面和手机模拟宽度；上游其余组件可直接从完整源码取材。
workflow: 先从八组样例观察控件状态与动效，确定当前页面所需能力。
在固定快照 registry.json 与 public/r/<名称>.json 中查看文件和依赖，再复制对应源码。
接入 foundation.css 和 motion-tokens，设置 @/ 路径别名，保留组件内部相对结构。
按真实业务替换 props、标签与数据；明暗主题、键盘和减少动态由目标页面一起管理。

relatedEntries.note: 同一产品的官网设计作为案例；本素材提供可取用的免费组件源码。

# Arc UI · React 动效组件库

[运行样例](../../demos/materials/arc-ui/index.html) · [素材条目](../../entries/materials/arc-ui.json) · [上游原文](../../demos/materials/arc-ui/source/upstream/README.md)

## 选择组件

八组中文样例使用上游真实组件，界面组合与业务数据由本库编写。按钮适合观察按压与结果交接；形变选择器和弹性滑块展示连续的几何反馈；标签页与计费开关展示选中位置和内容如何一起变化；折线图、对话框和通知提供更完整的状态路径。

样例支持明暗主题、四种强调色和手动减少动态。状态只存在于当前页面，可以通过重新进入样例恢复。它们是组件用法展示，官网布局另见 [官网案例](../../cases.html#style/uiarc-platform)。

## 取得源码

`source/upstream/registry/components/` 保存免费组件，`registry/blocks/` 保存免费组合区块，`registry/foundation.css` 和 `lib/motion-tokens.ts` 提供共享视觉与动效参数。完整安装清单在 `registry.json`；每项 `public/r/<名称>.json` 同时列出文件、外部包和组件依赖。

手工接入时，把需要的组件目录及其依赖复制到项目，保持上游目录关系，并将 `@/` 配置为复制后的源码根。导入 `foundation.css`，按目标项目设置字体与语义颜色，再替换组件 props、标签和业务数据。上游 README 还提供 shadcn registry 和 MCP 用法；在线入口的内容会变化，复用本次版本时以归档快照为准。

## 修改与重建样例

中文页面组合和示例数据在 `source/main.tsx`，样例外框在 `demo/demo.css`，组件原文保持不变。进入 `source/` 后运行：

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
```

构建使用随条目保存的锁文件，生成 `vendor/arc-ui@df3a600/` 的运行 JavaScript、CSS 与依赖许可。以 HTTP 服务打开本体入口即可使用，无需在查看时安装依赖。

## 在目标页面中使用

优先保留组件的键盘路径、焦点管理和减少动态分支，用目标页面的语义 tokens 统一样式。图表的标签、选择器的可访问名称和通知的动作应表达真实业务。示例价格与收录数量用于观察运动，不是产品信息。

素材范围、固定版本与许可事实见结构化条目；许可原文入口集中在 [LICENSES.md](../../demos/materials/arc-ui/LICENSES.md)。

# Arc UI · React 动效组件库（免费部分） · 复用 Prompt

[结构化条目](../../entries/materials/arc-ui.json)

在已有 React 页面中使用 Arc UI 免费组件。先读取固定源码、registry 安装条目、中文说明与运行样例，按任务选择 Button、MorphSelect、ElasticSlider、Tabs、BillingToggle、LineChart、Dialog 或 ToastStack。保留上游 TypeScript、CSS Modules、motion tokens 和键盘模型，接入 foundation.css，以语义变量切换明暗与强调色；只修改业务 props、数据和页面组合。保持按钮、输入和标签的可访问名称，尊重系统减少动态。源文件从 source/upstream/ 复制，依赖使用当前项目明确固定的版本，保留 MIT 与各运行依赖、字体许可。官网首页的布局应从独立案例取得，不把官网媒体当作组件实现。

## 制作约束

- 固定归档 df3a600 的 144 个 registry 条目：120 个 registry:ui、22 个 registry:block 和 2 个共享基础条目。
- 上游要求 React 19、TypeScript 与 Next.js 或 Vite；本地以 React 19.3.0、Motion 13.4.0 和固定锁文件捆绑八组样例。
- source/upstream/ 的 registry、lib、types、public/r 与根使用说明保留原始结构和字节，未引入上游的维护检查脚本。
- 样例数据、状态与操作仅作用于当前页面，不接入账户、支付或持久化服务。
- 浏览器实测覆盖本地 Chromium 桌面和手机模拟宽度；上游其余组件可直接从完整源码取材。

# 许可索引

- [Arc 免费源码 MIT](source/upstream/LICENSE)：组件、区块、共享逻辑、设计 tokens 与文档。
- [运行依赖清单](vendor/arc-ui@df3a600/licenses.json)：React、Motion、Radix 等实际捆绑版本及各自许可原文路径。
- [Inter · SIL OFL 1.1](fonts/Inter-OFL.txt) 与 [Geist · SIL OFL 1.1](fonts/Geist-OFL.txt)：官网使用的原始字体。

# 样例制作资料

`main.tsx` 组合上游组件，`build.mjs` 捆绑运行文件并收集依赖许可；依赖由 `package.json` 与 `package-lock.json` 固定。

`upstream/` 保存原始组件、区块、共享逻辑、类型、registry 安装条目与使用说明。版本及范围见素材条目。样例只导入实际使用的组件，完整免费源码仍可直接取用。

上游 `lib/media.ts` 引用的 `public/media/` 示例图片未随公开仓库提供。需要这些图片的区块可按文件内的 `/media/people/`、`/media/photos/` 路径从 `https://uiarc.dev` 获取并确认相应权利，或传入自己的图片；本地八组样例不依赖这些图片。

在本目录运行 `npm ci`、`npm run build`，输出到 `../vendor/arc-ui@df3a600/`。使用与修改说明见 [中文文档](../../../../docs/materials/arc-ui.md)。

Arc is a library of React components and blocks with motion built in. Every item is plain source you own: CSS modules on a small set of design tokens, [Motion](https://motion.dev) for animation, keyboard support, and a reduced motion path for every animation. Install anything with the shadcn CLI or copy the files by hand. It works in Next.js and Vite, with or without Tailwind. This repository holds the free, open source part: **120 components and 22 blocks**, plus the design and motion tokens they share. Every one of them has a live preview at [uiarc.dev](https://uiarc.dev). ## Showcase A few favorites, recorded live from [uiarc.dev](https://uiarc.dev). Items marked Pro are part of [Arc Pro](https://uiarc.dev/pro) and are not in this repository; everything else installs from here for free.

Cover flow Pro
A depth rail of photos you can throw, with soft grounded shadows and a quiet reflection.
Donut chart
Arcs morph between datasets while the total rolls into the center.

Billing toggle
Monthly and yearly prices roll into each other, savings included.
Orbit logos Pro
Integrations orbit your product mark. Filter them by category.

Wallet stack Pro
Fan a stack of cards and lift one out to see its activity.
Line chart
Switch the range and the line redraws against the previous period.

Number field
Bounded steppers that say so when you reach the limit.
Activity rings Pro
Daily goals sweep, count up and trace a second lap past 100%.
## Contents - [Showcase](#showcase) - [Install](#install) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [With the shadcn CLI](#with-the-shadcn-cli) - [Copy and paste](#copy-and-paste) - [Usage](#usage) - [Theming](#theming) - [Components](#components) - [Blocks](#blocks) - [AI tools](#ai-tools) - [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [How releases work](#how-releases-work) - [Repository layout](#repository-layout) - [Arc Pro](#arc-pro) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [License](#license) ## Install ### Requirements - **React 19** with TypeScript. The source compiles under `strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` and `verbatimModuleSyntax`, and needs `lib` ES2023 or newer (a few items use `findLast`) - **Next.js** (App Router) or **Vite** - **[motion](https://www.npmjs.com/package/motion)** for animation. Some items also use [lucide-react](https://lucide.dev) or a [Radix UI](https://www.radix-ui.com) primitive; the CLI installs whatever an item needs. - The `@/*` import alias (Next.js and shadcn set it up by default) No Tailwind is required. Arc styles are CSS modules that read CSS variables. ### With the shadcn CLI Register the `@uiarc` namespace once in `components.json`: ```json { "registries": { "@uiarc": "https://uiarc.dev/r/{name}.json" } } ``` Then add items by name. Local dependencies, such as the components inside a block, come along automatically: ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @uiarc/button @uiarc/dialog ``` Every item also installs from its full URL, without touching `components.json`: ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://uiarc.dev/r/button.json ``` Install the design tokens once per app with `npx shadcn@latest add @uiarc/arc-foundation`, then import them at the root of your app. Components only pull in the motion presets (`arc-motion-tokens`) and never reinstall `foundation.css`, so you can also keep the tokens in your own theme package. ```tsx // app/layout.tsx (Next.js) or src/main.tsx (Vite) import "@/components/arc/foundation.css"; ```
Setting up a new project
**Next.js** ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app npx shadcn@latest init ``` Accept the default `@/*` import alias. **Vite** ```bash npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts cd my-app npx shadcn@latest init ``` Map `@/*` to `src` in `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`, as shadcn expects: ```json { "compilerOptions": { "baseUrl": ".", "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } } } ``` ```ts import path from "node:path"; import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react"; import { defineConfig } from "vite"; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [react()], resolve: { alias: { "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "./src") } }, }); ```
### Copy and paste 1. Install the shared packages: `npm install motion lucide-react`. 2. Copy `registry/foundation.css`, `registry/motion-tokens.ts` and `lib/motion-tokens.ts` from this repository into the same paths under your `@/` root, and import the CSS once at the root. 3. Copy the item's folder from `registry/components//` or `registry/blocks//`, keeping the path. Copied files keep this repository's layout and import each other through `@/`; the CLI install above rewrites that for you. Its `public/r/.json` file lists every file and npm package it needs. Each page on [uiarc.dev](https://uiarc.dev/components) also has a Manual tab with the exact files. ## Usage The CLI puts every file in an `arc/` folder under the `components` alias in your `components.json`, for example `components/arc/button/button.tsx`, or `src/components/arc/…` in a `src/` project or monorepo package. Arc files import each other with relative paths, so any alias setup works; move the `arc/` folder as a whole if you want it elsewhere. Use them like any local component: ```tsx import { Button } from "@/components/arc/button/button"; export default function Page() { return ; } ``` The code is yours: edit it, rename it, move it. There is no runtime package to keep in sync. ## Theming Components read semantic tokens, never raw colors. Change a token in `foundation.css` (`components/arc/foundation.css` after a CLI install) and every component follows, in both themes. | Token | Used for | | --- | --- | | `--background` | The page behind everything | | `--surface`, `--surface-raised`, `--surface-muted` | Cards and inputs, floating layers, quiet fills | | `--foreground`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-muted` | Primary, supporting and hint text | | `--border`, `--border-subtle`, `--border-strong` | Separators and edges | | `--accent`, `--accent-strong`, `--accent-subtle` | Selection, progress and helpful context | | `--success`, `--warning`, `--danger` | Status, always paired with a label | | `--radius-control`, `--radius-panel`, `--radius-surface` | Controls, menus, cards | | `--font-display`, `--font-body` | Geist for headings, Inter for everything else | - **Dark mode:** set `data-theme="dark"` on ``. Dark values are tuned separately, not inverted. - **Accent:** set `data-accent` on `` to `neutral`, `violet`, `blue`, `green`, `amber`, `orange`, `coral` or `rose`. - **Motion:** springs and durations live in `lib/motion-tokens.ts` (`components/arc/lib/motion-tokens.ts` after a CLI install). Every animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. More in the [theming docs](https://uiarc.dev/docs/theming) and [motion docs](https://uiarc.dev/docs/motion). ## Components 120 free components, grouped as on the site. Setup for each client is in the [AI and MCP docs](https://uiarc.dev/docs/ai). ## Troubleshooting
Cannot find module @/registry/...
Arc files import each other through the `@/*` alias. Map it to your project root in `tsconfig.json` (and in `vite.config.ts` for Vite). See [Setting up a new project](#with-the-shadcn-cli).
Components render without styles or colors
Import the tokens once at the root: `import "@/registry/foundation.css";`. If the file is missing, run `npx shadcn@latest add @uiarc/arc-foundation`.
The CLI says @uiarc is an unknown registry
Add the `registries` entry to `components.json` (see [With the shadcn CLI](#with-the-shadcn-cli)), or install from the full URL: `npx shadcn@latest add https://uiarc.dev/r/.json`.
Dark mode does not switch
Arc follows the `data-theme` attribute on ``, not the `dark` class. Set `data-theme="dark"` before the page paints to avoid a flash of the light theme.
Links and images: using next/link, next/image or your own components
Components render a plain `` and ``, so they work in Vite, Remix, Astro or plain React. To route them through Next.js, or through your own `Link` (for example a locale-aware one), wrap the app once with `ArcProvider`. It installs with the components that use it. ```tsx "use client"; import Image from "next/image"; import Link from "next/link"; import { ArcProvider } from "@/components/arc/lib/arc-provider"; export function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) { return {children}; } ``` `link` receives `href` plus anchor attributes, and `image` receives `src`, `alt`, `width` and `height` or `fill`, `sizes` and `priority`, the same props next/image takes. A few blocks are Next.js page examples and still import `next/image` or `next/link` directly: [`changelog-feed`](https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/changelog-feed), [`site-header`](https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/site-header), [`newsletter-signup`](https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/newsletter-signup). In another framework, replace `Image` with `` (or `ArcImage` from `arc-provider`) and `Link` with ``.
Animations do not play
Arc honors the reduced motion setting of your operating system and swaps movement for simple fades. Turn it off to see the full motion, and make sure `motion` is installed.
The CLI asks to overwrite foundation.css
Only `arc-foundation` writes `foundation.css`; components and blocks depend on `arc-motion-tokens` instead. If you re-run `add @uiarc/arc-foundation` after customizing your tokens, answer no to keep your file, or keep your overrides in a separate stylesheet loaded after it.
